Class Elevator

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.SmartPositionalMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.Elevator
yams.commands2.mechanisms.Elevator
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommandMechanism
public class Elevator extends Elevator implements CommandMechanism
Command-based extension of Elevator that adds the Subsystem binding and Command/Trigger factories.

Usage Example

SmartMotorController motor = new TalonFXWrapper(
    new TalonFX(4), DCMotor.getKrakenX60(1),
    new SmartMotorControllerConfig(this).withClosedLoopController(0.5,0,0).withFeedforward(new
ElevatorFeedforward(0.4,0,0)); Elevator elevator = new Elevator( new
ElevatorConfig(motor).withDrumRadius(Inches.of(1.0)));

// Move to heights
Command toHigh = elevator.setHeight(Meters.of(1.2));
Command toLow  = elevator.runTo(Meters.of(0.05), Meters.of(0.01));

// Trigger bindings
elevator.near(Meters.of(1.2), Meters.of(0.02)).onTrue(shooter.shoot());
elevator.max().onTrue(Commands.print("Elevator at max"));

// In periodic():
elevator.simIterate();
elevator.updateTelemetry();

  • Constructor Details

    • Elevator

      public Elevator(ElevatorConfig config, SmartMotorController smc)
      Construct the Elevator class for easy manipulation of an elevator.
      Parameters:
      config - ElevatorConfig to set.
      smc - SmartMotorController to use for the Elevator
      Throws:
      ElevatorConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the carriage mass is not configured.
      ElevatorConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the minimum or maximum height is not configured.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if smc's config does not have a Subsystem set via withSubsystem(Subsystem).
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the starting position is not configured.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the mechanism circumference is not configured.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the starting height is outside the hard limits.
      Implementation Note:
      smc's config must be a SmartMotorControllerConfig with a Subsystem set via withSubsystem(Subsystem).

    • runTo

      public org.wpilib.command2.Command runTo(org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance height, org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance tolerance)
      Run the elevator to the desired height with a tolerance, then move on.
      Parameters:
      height - Height to reach.
      tolerance - The acceptable tolerance
      Returns:
      Command which will run the elevator to the desired height with a tolerance, then move on.
      Implementation Note:
      This should NOT be used with a default command, the mechanism will not stop running after this to allow for easy chaining.
